title: Device Simulator Configuration
description: Schema for validating simulated IoT device telemetry data.

deviceId.description: Unique identifier of the simulated IoT device.

intervalMs.description: Interval in milliseconds between two telemetry messages.

telemetry.description: List of telemetry values that will be sent periodically.

temperature.description: Temperature value measured by the simulated device.

humidity.description: Humidity percentage measured by the simulated device.

pressure.description: Atmospheric pressure measured by the simulated device.

mode.description: Operating mode of the simulated device.
